test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: CARROT is related to TRIIFK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way. QUILL is related to HLZCC. To which of the following is PIEGION related, following the same logic?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, CARROT is related to TRIIFK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bddcc04313a266f2b5058385bbef2d5d1101e244564468530bcc6e8f87238831.png] 

For, QUILL is related to HLZCC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e2f9547ad11a5c0967aeccead67247b394e89371cbcee4eaeb692c907710f9d.png] 

Similarly, for PIEGION

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e2ee03d46767a52dfceeab5894ee4238d7bc125f57cef947d211fd18de3e896.png] 

So, **PIEGION **will be written as **GZVXZFE.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 3'.***
